beats.summary: Jim conducts a dog salivation experiment using Altoids.

evidence.snippet: Jim: In school, we learned about this scientist who trained dogs to salivate at the sound of a bell by feeding them whenever a bell rang.

beats.summary: Jim and Dwight discuss wedding crashers and Jim wishes to investigate them.

evidence.snippet: Jim: You know I just wish, I wish, I had the investigative powers to smoke some of these guys out.
Dwight: Once again, Jim, I will take care of this. I will locate the wedding crashers and report them to Phyllis.

beats.summary: Phyllis is getting married and has asked Michael to be part of her wedding.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Phyllis is getting married. And I am in the wedding party.
Phyllis: Yes, I put Michael in my wedding.

beats.summary: Michael walks Phyllis' father, Albert, down the aisle, causing a surprise.

evidence.snippet: Michael: This strappy young lad sitting here is Phyllis' father, Albert, and he is quite the ladies' man, aren't you Albert, hah?
Albert gets out of his wheelchair and starts walking

beats.summary: The wedding ceremony concludes with the couple being married and Michael celebrating.

evidence.snippet: Priest: And do you, Phyllis, take Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration, to be your lawfully wedded husband?
Michael: Ladies and Gentleman, for the first time as a couple, Mr. and Mrs. Bob Vance.

beats.summary: Michael makes a humorous and protective speech about Phyllis and her new husband.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Congratulations, Bob. You're a good man. But just know… if you ever lay a finger on Phyllis, I will kill you.
Michael: Agreed. No fingers will be laid on Phyllis.
